summary: The change reaches the grocery counter when bottled water becomes redeemable.
realLife: Oregon’s 2007 legislation brought water and flavored water into the system at the beginning of 2009.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: coverage dates and store return instructions.

turns.what: The store adds water bottles to its return instructions on the effective date.
turns.pulledBy: Water is newly included and the effective date has arrived.
turns.writesBack: The store starts crediting eligible water returns.

turns.what: If lawmakers later remove water, the store preserves a separate list for any transition refunds.
turns.pulledBy: A later amendment removes water but preserves some old claims.
turns.writesBack: The clerk retains the transition instructions.
